clues.question: With species found in Chile and many African estuaries, what birds in the genus Phoenicopterus tilt their heads upside-down to feed?
Using their extra long backwards-bending ankles, what tropical birds can sleep for hours at a time with one leg tucked under their feathers?
Born grey and white, what leggy birds turn pink over time due to their diet of beta-carotene-rich foods like shrimp?
An old man is killed seemingly because he has a pale blue "vulture-like" eye, in what short story that was first published in 1843 in "The Pioneer"?
Edgar Allan Poe's unreliable narrator confesses to murder and demands the policemen tear up the floorboards, at the end of what seminal work?
Thump, thump! Thump, thump! Said narrator can't stop hearing what title object that is somehow still beating even after its owner is long dead?
Chrain is the Yiddish name for what spice and condiment that's often mixed with beetroot in Ashkenazi and Slavic cuisine?
Modern "wasabi" is often made with what grated white plant that's mixed with mayo or other salad dressings when served as a sauce in the US?
Though some think it got its name from the term "mare radish," no equines are harmed in the making of what prime rib dip with a little zip?
The ancient Roman cities of Sabratha and Leptis Magna sit on the Mediterranean coast, in what modern-day OPEC nation?
A 2011 uprising in Benghazi led to a civil war in what North African country whose capital is mentioned in the U.S. Marine Corps Hymn?
The former home of ousted dictator Muammar Gadafi, Tripoli is the capital of what country between Egypt and Algeria?
Though better known for film, what actress plays Carmy's mother on "The Bear" and is appearing in "Newlyweds" this fall?
What "Freaky Friday" actress got an Oscar for playing the IRS agent Deirdre in "Everything Everywhere All at Once"?
Hollywood royalty Janet Leigh and Tony Curtis are the parents of what acclaimed yogurt spokeswoman and star of the "Halloween" franchise?
